verdict.rationale: Reader's core function turns any URL into clean, LLM-ready text or markdown through one endpoint. It handles rendering itself with a headless Chrome engine and wait-for-selector, and handles blocking with a hosted rotating proxy that clears common anti-bot challenges. The community items are open questions or errors from a third-party tool, not contradictions. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of output cleanliness on hard pages, anti-bot proxy requires an API key

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get clean LLM-ready text directly instead of dealing with blocking, rendering, and messy HTML myself

citations.quote: The Reader API provides a streamlined, reliable output of clean, LLM-ready text.
It converts any URL to an **LLM-friendly** input with `https://r.jina.ai/https://your.url`.
`x-engine` — enforces a fetching engine: `browser` (headless Chrome), `curl` (lightweight, no JS), or `auto`
Reader's hosted proxy pool rotates residential / datacenter IPs and handles common anti-bot challenges automatically.
